Astrolabe Collector, way 1: install it once (best)

A small script for the game page. It reads what the game already shows you and brings it here. It never clicks and never plays. The only thing it ever asks the game is the public market price list, with your own API key (the game's rules allow scripts for information only).
  1. Install Tampermonkey in the browser you play in: tampermonkey.net (Chrome, Edge, Firefox). In Chrome, also allow it to run scripts: Extensions › Tampermonkey › Details › "Allow user scripts".
  2. Install the Collector: Install Astrolabe Collector
    Tampermonkey opens: click Install. You had the PvP Collector? This is its new version: click Update (or Reinstall). If you then see both "PvP Collector" and "Astrolabe Collector" in Tampermonkey, delete the old one.
  3. Open the game in that browser (steam.stellarodyssey.app) or reload it. An "Astrolabe Collector" button shows in the game's top bar, left of the crown (bottom left corner while the game is still loading).
  4. Come back to this site in the same browser (reload it once after installing). Your game shows here by itself and follows the game tab live. Nothing to tick.
Green dot on the button = sending works. Orange = an update is out (its box has an Update button). Red = sending failed; it tries again by itself.

Astrolabe Collector, way 2: a bookmark (nothing to install)

The same Collector, started by a click on a bookmark instead of Tampermonkey. Always the newest version. Good for a PC where you cannot or do not want to install an extension.
  1. Show your bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B), then drag this button onto it: Astrolabe Collector
  2. Open the game (steam.stellarodyssey.app), then click that bookmark. The "Astrolabe Collector" button appears in the game's top bar.
  3. Its box opens by itself: click Open Astrolabe in it. This site opens in a new tab, linked to your game tab: your game shows here live, straight from that tab. Always come here through that button: a tab you open yourself (a bookmark of this site, a typed address) is not linked and stays empty.
  4. Click the bookmark again each time you open or reload the game. The link to this site comes back by itself.
Use one way or the other; if both are there, only one runs. Web browsers only: the Steam app cannot run the Collector, so open the game in a browser with the same account.

For the PvP page: let the Collector see your fights

  1. New squadron battles, Arena duels and Squadron Groups are picked up as the game loads them. Nothing to do.
  2. For older fights, open once in the game: Battlefield › Battle Log › Squadron (50 per page, each page), Battle Log › Arena, and Squadron Groups.
  3. For an Arena opponent never seen in a squadron battle, click View battle on one of their duels.
  4. A battle you watch on your phone reaches the planner only when a game tab on the PC loads it: reload the game or open the Battle Log there.

Market prices: one call refreshes everyone

Prices are the same for every player, so they are shared. The game makes a new price list every hour. When one is due, a single member's Collector fetches it from the game's public API with that player's own key and shares it with everyone here: about 24 calls a day for the whole squadron, at most 6 a day from one player by itself (of the 50 the game allows each key). The Refresh button on the Gathering and Market pages asks your own Collector to do it now. You can switch this off in the Collector's box ("Help keep market prices fresh").
What goes where, and who can see it
  1. Your game data (droids, ship, skills, inventory, laboratory, levels, currencies, your equipment's icons): with Tampermonkey it stays in your browser; the Collector hands it from your game tab to this site on your own PC. Either way it is yours alone: no other member can see it.
  2. Your API key: the Collector reads it from the game page and keeps it on your PC. It is only ever sent to the game itself (for the market price list). Not to Astrolabe's server, and this page never sees it.
  3. Market prices: shared with everyone who uses Astrolabe, with the name of the member whose Collector fetched them (the admin sees that list).
  4. Fights (squadron battles, Arena duels and results, Squadron Groups, member list, your own PvP build): shared with everyone who uses Astrolabe or the planner.
  5. Private copy on the server: paused while the site has no sign-in (it needs one, so that only you can read it). Your game reaches this site inside your browser only.

Signed in here with your admin passphrase and your game key (checked by the Astrolabe server; nothing here can open it for anyone else). Open it in its own tab
